summary.zh: 点一下，把正在写的草稿变成清晰提示词：确认页先预览，复制或追加随你选。设置页可配预设、详细/中等/简易三档长度，以及保留专有名词、保留代码与路径、改写说明、附加指令与启停开关。不发送消息，不额外联网。
summary.en: Tap once: the draft you are writing becomes a sharper prompt, previewed before it touches the composer — copy or append, your call. A settings page holds presets, a three-tier length (detailed / medium / short) and switches for proper nouns, code and paths, rewrite notes, an extra instruction and the master switch. Nothing is sent; no extra network calls.
